findings.conclusion: No singleton-only invariant was established. The deferred global admission changes original latest-request ordering across managers. Root and W1 acknowledged R1 must remain held.
findings.boundedRemedy: Reserve global request authority in the existing Coordinator before the first new suspension; require that reservation before beginRun can mutate/cancel another run, and recheck after its await. Original direct/synchronous beginRun callers must also supersede stale reservations. Completion/cancellation of A must not revoke an unrelated newer B/C reservation; matching Stop/deletion still defeats waiting B.
